projects.name: gepa-adk
projects.description: Evolutionary prompt optimization for AI agents using Google ADK. Automatically evolves agent instructions through iterative improvement. Async-first engine with hexagonal architecture and protocol-based interfaces. Apache-2.0.

projects.name: adk-secure-sessions
projects.description: Encrypted session storage for Google ADK agents. Drop-in replacement using Fernet encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation. Apache-2.0.

projects.name: docvet
projects.description: CLI tool for Python docstring quality vetting. 32 rules across five checks (presence, enrichment, freshness, griffe, mkdocs coverage), including git-based staleness detection via diff and blame. Production/Stable. MIT.

projects.name: vramfit
projects.description: Hardware-targeted LLM quantization. Measures per-layer compression damage, then solves a mixed-precision recipe against a real VRAM budget (scan → plan → pack). Fit Llama-3.3-Nemotron-Super-49B onto a single 24 GiB RTX 4090: 20.36 GiB packed against a 20.47 GiB weight budget, beating every in-budget baseline on KL divergence. Three packs published across three model families and 24/16 GiB budgets, with per-layer sensitivity maps for the Nemotron packs published for independent reproduction. MIT.

projects.name: saucier
projects.description: Provenance-first extraction: parses Escoffier's January 1909 edition into a catalogue of 151 preparations where every claim traces to a source line, with no model in the loop. Publishes the deterministic baseline (94 of 151 state no base) that a later agentic system must beat. 8 ADRs, Diátaxis documentation, API reference generated from docstrings. MIT.

projects.name: turboquant-vllm
projects.description: First TurboQuant vLLM plugin, built paper-to-PyPI in 72 hours after Google's ICLR 2026 publication. 3.76x KV cache compression across 7 model families; fused paged kernels cut memory traffic 8.5x.

projects.name: typevet
projects.description: Asks an open model typed questions about text and images and reads each answer as a probability from its next-token distribution; runs Gemma 4 31B on a 24 GiB card (llama.cpp or vLLM). With a receipt photo attached it caught 6 of 6 swapped totals that Gemma, reading text alone, had passed as "match" at ≥99.96% confidence. A pre-registered calibration study (16 series, decision rule and split fixed before any fit) found isotonic recalibration sufficient on 5 of 6 decision series, so it recommended against fine-tuning. MIT.

projects.name: judgevet
projects.description: Typed Python client, CLI and MCP server for TypeSafe's Jev judgment model, with a published calibration study: Jev's scam-text calibration gap measured at 7 points (ECE 0.073) with sorting score 0.995. Ships a verification ledger that separates live-verified from inferred API claims, checked by a dedicated auditing agent. MIT.
